cards.title: Pair of Stained Glass Panels with Male and Female Donor
cards.medium: pot metal, white glass with silver stain
cards.extract: The origin of these stained glass panels is unknown. They depict a male and female donor, presumably husband and wife, who gaze upon a now-lost central panel. The object of their devotions was likely a crucified Christ or a standing figure of the Virgin Mary. The man, dressed in armor, and the woman, wearing a bejeweled and richly embroidered gown, are accompanied by their not yet identified coats-of-arms. They are undoubtedly members of an aristocratic elite who commissioned these windows, perhaps for a family chapel.

cards.title: Baird Architects releases first furniture collection as "natural extension" of studio
cards.extract: US architecture studio Baird Architects has released its inaugural furniture collection, with seating, tables, and shelving, designed by in-house architects and collaborators and made in Portugal. The twelve-piece BA Objeto collection was led by Baird Architects founder Matthew Baird, who designed several pieces and also commissioned studio employees and collaborators. cards.title: reclaiming swiss auto waste, it all remains turns decommissioned cars into building resources
cards.extract: it all remains, an installation by giona bierens de haan, addresses automotive waste in switzerland by reinterpreting decommissioned vehicles as structural building blocks and local resources for a post-fossil-fuel architecture. The post reclaiming swiss auto waste, it all remains turns decommissioned cars into building resources appeared first on designboom | architecture & design magazine .

cards.title: CCLM 280 House / Barbalaco Arquitectos
